final: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS status, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY s.healtheval), overall_total AS (SELECT SUM(group_count) AS total FROM status_counts), shares AS (SELECT g.group_count, CAST(g.group_count AS REAL) / t.total AS share FROM status_counts AS g JOIN overall_total AS t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(sh.group_count) AS average_group_count, AVG(sh.share) AS average_share, AVG(sh.share - a.average_share) AS average_share_difference FROM shares AS sh JOIN overall_average AS a ON a.average_share IS NOT NULL WHERE sh.share > a.average_share
